newsItems.title: Friend re-launches its AI pendant with a speaker that talks to you, for twice the price
newsItems.summary: Do you remember Friend? The Friend that launched an AI pendant, spent $1.8 million of its $2.5 million to acquire friend.com, and plastered the NYC subway with ads promoting artificial companionship? Yeah well, if you didn't remember, Friend is back. And now, it's twice the pric…

newsItems.titleZh: Friend 重新推出人工智能吊坠，带有能与你说话的扬声器，价格是原来的两倍
newsItems.summaryZh: 你还记得朋友吗？ The Friend 推出了人工智能挂件，斥资 250 万美元中的 180 万美元收购了friend.com，还在纽约地铁上贴满了宣传人工陪伴的广告？是的，如果你不记得的话，朋友回来了。而现在，价格翻了两倍……

newsItems.summary: Google DeepMind says the latest version of its Gemini Robotics AI model can "control entire humanoid robots." While the previous model focused on controlling a humanoid robot's upper body, Gemini Robotics 2 now supports "whole-body motions" ranging from its feet to fingertips, a…
newsItems.whyItMatters: AI 正从屏幕进入真实世界，可靠感知和长期执行能力成为关键门槛。

newsItems.title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
newsItems.summary: The deal gives Okta identity threat detection capabilities as enterprises seek to secure AI agents and other non-human identities across cloud environments.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 智能体能否连接工具并稳定完成任务，决定 AI 从回答问题走向交付结果的速度。
newsItems.titleZh: Okta 收购人工智能安全初创公司 Permiso；消息人士称，价格约为 2 亿美元
newsItems.summaryZh: 当企业寻求跨云环境保护人工智能代理和其他非人类身份时，这笔交易为 Okta 提供了身份威胁检测功能。

newsItems.title: Chrome Needs Twice-a-Week Patching Thanks to AI Bug Hunting
newsItems.summary: The two Chrome updates in June patched more bugs than the 23 updates before them. Now, Google is ramping up its patching schedule thanks to AI-assisted vulnerability discovery.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 新产品与功能展示了 AI 能力进入实际工作流的最新路径。
newsItems.titleZh: 由于 AI 错误搜寻，Chrome 需要每周两次打补丁
newsItems.summaryZh: 6 月份的两次 Chrome 更新修复的错误比之前的 23 次更新要多。现在，借助人工智能辅助的漏洞发现，谷歌正在加快其补丁计划。
